## fru-tracker: A Service Generated by Fabrica

`smd2` is a new OpenCHAMI inventory service developed with help from Fabrica.
It can act as a replacement for the [smd project](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/smd).

smd2 implements enough of the APIs on smd to be a drop in replacement for smd in OpenCHAMI.
The goal is to have enough of the original smd's APIs such that it still works for exiting clients of smd,
for example, pcs can still use it without having to make changes.

smd supports storing the state of the nodes, and it does discovery of those nodes. smd2 only supports storing the state of the nodes.
In OpenCHAMI the discovery of the nodes is done outside of smd.

The rationale for creating smd2 is to have a service that is less complex then the current smd.
It does this by not bringing forward the discovery capabilities. 
Furthermore, it makes it easier to add in new APIs and capabilities.
This makes the service behave similar to other OpenCHAMI services.

## Running the Service

The service can be run in multiple ways

### 1. Run in the quickstart

This shows how to run in the [quickstart guide](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/deployment-recipes/tree/main/quickstart)

Replace the `SMD Init and Server Containers` with the following

```
###
# SMD Server Container
###
  # sets up postgres for SMD data
  # SMD
  smd:
    image: smd2:latest
    container_name: smd
    hostname: smd
    environment:
      - SMD_PORT=27779
    depends_on:
      opaal:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "--silent", "http://localhost:27779/health"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 60
      start_period: 20s
      timeout: 10s
    networks:
      - internal
```

### 2. Run in a quadlet

This shows to how to run as a quadlet as is done in the [turtorial](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/tutorial-2025)

Create the file `smd2.container` in `/etc/containers/systemd` with the following contents

```
[Unit]
Description=The smd container
PartOf=openchami.target

# Don’t start until its init has run (and propagate failures):
Requires=openchami-internal-network.service openchami-jwt-internal-network.service
After=openchami-internal-network.service openchami-jwt-internal-network.service


# Don’t start until JWKS is ready:
Wants=hydra-gen-jwks.service
After=hydra-gen-jwks.service

[Container]
ContainerName=smd2
HostName=smd
Image=ghcr.io/openchami/smd2:v0.00.1

# Environment Variables
EnvironmentFile=/etc/openchami/configs/openchami.env

# Networks for the Container to use
Network=openchami-internal.network

# Unsupported by generator options
# Proxy settings
PodmanArgs=--http-proxy=false

[Service]
Restart=always
```
### 3. Run from local source

```
make build
```
```
mkdir -p data
```
```
./bin/smd2-server serve --database-url "file:data/smd2.db?_fk=1"
```

See the learn by example section in (fabrica)[https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/fabrica?tab=readme-ov-file#-learn-by-example]
